must_haves: security and where data is stored (Stockholm)

layout.idea: Alternating rows with bleed: text in 5 left columns, screenshot in 7 columns bleeding off the right edge of the viewport, five rows.
layout.why: A familiar reading rhythm that gives screenshots room at real size.

hero.idea: A 3D envelope with the draft pulled halfway out, a strong long shadow, H1 beside it.
hero.why: A calm, ownable object instead of an abstract graphic.

visual_style.idea: Blueprint grid: faint 8px grid on the page background in a very light cobalt tint, diagrams drawn in cobalt lines, screenshots unframed.
visual_style.why: Technical honesty; the grid also aligns everything.

typography.idea: Fraunces 600 (opsz 144, SOFT 0) for H1 and H2, Instrument Sans 400/500 body at 18px, IBM Plex Mono 400 for email addresses and the connector URL.
typography.why: A warm serif display with plain body text; mono marks anything you can copy.

narrative.idea: By hand versus connected: the same task shown twice, once copying between inbox and chat, once with MCPEmails.
narrative.why: Compares against the real alternative (doing it yourself), not competitors.

proof.idea: Install screenshots inside each client's connector settings (Claude, ChatGPT), showing the real connector entry.
proof.why: Proves the integration is real, not a mockup.

asset_use.idea: The 3D postbox appears once, as the anchor of the 'Connect your inbox' section, its slots labelled with provider names.
asset_use.why: One strong object at the step it represents.

motion.idea: Copy feedback on the connector URL: 'Copied' replaces the button label for two seconds.
motion.why: Functional motion that confirms an action.

section_order.idea: Hero > Security first (never stored, Stockholm, encrypted, revoke) > Demo > Providers > Pricing > FAQ
section_order.why: For buyers whose first question is privacy.

voice.idea: FAQ plainness. Sample: 'Does it store my email? No. It fetches it when asked.'
voice.why: Answers in the reader's own words.

wildcard.idea: Only three font sizes on the whole page.
